Description

In an MMD world, station animations are not synchronized between players on the Live version and players on the Open Beta version. From one player's perspective, their own avatar plays the animation normally, while the other player's avatar remains standing in place and twitches slightly. This issue does not occur if both players are on the same version (i.e., both on Live or both on Open Beta).

Reproduction Steps

Reproduction Steps:

1. Have two players on different versions: one on the Live version and one on the Open Beta version.

2. Both players stand on the station and click Play so their avatars begin playing the animation.

3. The issue occurs.

Temporary Workaround:

Both players switch to the same version (i.e., both on Live or both on Open Beta).
